ios.desc:
Forgetting what you study? You're not alone.

Space is the flashcard app that makes remembering effortless. Beautiful design. Zero setup. Just open and learn.

Join 160,000+ learners who created over 6.9 million flashcards with Space.

---

WHY LEARNERS CHOOSE SPACE

SIMPLE & BEAUTIFUL
No confusing settings. No cluttered interface. Just you and your cards. Open the app and start learning in seconds.

REMEMBER FOREVER
Our spaced repetition algorithm learns your memory patterns and shows cards right before you forget. Study less, remember more. The same science trusted by medical students worldwide.

WORKS OFFLINE
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Learn anywhere with full offline support. Your progress syncs automatically when you reconnect.

AI CREATES CARDS FOR YOU
Paste a URL, upload a PDF or EPUB, or snap a photo of your notes. Space transforms any source into perfect flashcards in seconds.

MASTER ANY LANGUAGE
Japanese (JLPT N5-N1), Spanish, German, Korean, Chinese, and 50+ more. Over 600,000 language cards from our community.

BUILT FOR MED STUDENTS
Anatomy, pathology, pharmacology, biochemistry. Trusted by medical and nursing students preparing for USMLE, NCLEX, and board exams.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Streaks, daily goals, and detailed statistics keep you motivated. Take rest days without breaking your streak.

10,000+ COMMUNITY DECKS
Browse JLPT vocabulary, anatomy atlases, history timelines, and more. Start learning instantly.

IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE
Anki (with your learning progress intact), CSV, Excel, Google Sheets. Switch to Space in minutes, not hours.

RICH CARD FORMATS
Images, math formulas, drawings, code blocks, and GIFs. Create cards as detailed as your subject demands.

SYNC ACROSS ALL DEVICES
Start on iPhone, continue on iPad, finish on Mac. Your progress follows you everywhere.

STUDY TOGETHER
Share decks with classmates. Learn together, succeed together.

---

HOW SPACE WORKS

1. Create or find flashcards - Build your own deck, generate with AI, or browse 10,000+ community decks
2. Study with spaced repetition - Our algorithm schedules reviews at the perfect time for your memory
3. Remember forever - Watch your knowledge grow as you study less and retain more

---

WHAT'S INCLUDED FOR FREE

- Unlimited flashcards and decks
- Spaced repetition algorithm
- Full offline support
- Sync across all your devices
- Streaks and daily goals
- Rich formatting (images, math, code, drawings)
- Text-to-speech in 40+ languages
- Dark mode
- Import from Anki, CSV, Ex

quotes.text:
A spaced repetition flashcard app with the main focus on creating flashcards together. Sharing is still missing, but we are starting to work on it: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.space.space or https://apps.apple.com/us/app/space-spaced-repetition/id1546202212.

I'm still a student and started programming the app with a friend because I wanted to learn physics with my classmates. But the other apps Anki, Brainscape and Quizlet have a pretty bad UX to create flashcards collaboratively, so I started working on it.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Show me your half baked project
